scope: Actual matching Sampler9 opt2 WASM, same unmodified Game726, named fixture/seed42/1600x900; inventory at frame18 then3600 sequential fixed empty-input ticks in12 independent300-tick sampling=true windows. Tickwall brackets only unone_web_tick, excluding setter, Node decoding, profile requests and file IO. Instrumented diagnosis, not realtime FPS.
limits: Sampling=true opt2 diagnostic instrumentation changes wall time; no production FPS, renderer or browser evidence.
luau_memory_bytes is passive current allocated bytes queried at each stop boundary, not reachable/live heap or a window peak; includes dead pending-GC data, stacks, bytecode and table capacities.
VM allocation growth is cumulative positive allocator-growth requests/events; performance netpositiveheapdelta is not equivalent and is retained without treating it as total traffic.
Natural incremental GC callback wall/step counters are not V8 events, complete collector cycles or OS stop-the-world pauses.
Tickwall includes actual existing ABI publication/save work but excludes setter, Node observation decoding, developer commands and file IO. No forced GC, Game edits or clock/scheduler patches.
Stack callers and source samples are attribution evidence, not exact call/decode/miss counts. Existing scalar observations do not expose repository hit/miss/decode totals; none are invented.
Different per-block sampled totals can reflect longer work; absolute samples and same300tick denominator are preserved.
